confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description: Found **{name}**. Continue to pair — you will be asked to press **Trust** in the myVAILLANT app on the next page.

pair.title: Press Trust in the myVAILLANT app
pair.description: Open the myVAILLANT app on your phone, find the new SHIP device **{client_name}** (full SKI: `{client_ski}`) and press **Trust**. This page will advance automatically once the gateway accepts pairing.

progress.pairing: Waiting for you to press Trust on **{client_name}** in the myVAILLANT app…

error.handshake_failed: The pairing handshake failed (trust was denied or timed out). Try again.
error.gateway_not_found: No Vaillant gateway answered mDNS within the timeout. Check that the device is on the same network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error during pairing — check the Home Assistant log.

abort.not_supported: The discovered service is not a Vaillant gateway.
